pages.text: $(thing)Quirks$() are a personality expression system $(#FF69B4)exclusive to player nekos$().$(br2)Unlike NPC moe tags, quirks are your chosen "personality signature" — they don't change your stats, but they make your neko life much more colorful.

pages.title: How Quirks Express
pages.text: Quirks trigger unique effects during these $(#FF69B4)life events$():$(br2)$(li)$(#FF69B4)Taking damage$(): sends different messages based on damage severity$(li)$(#FF69B4)Attacking$(): sends different messages based on target's remaining HP$(li)$(#FF69B4)Weather changes$(): reactions to rain, clear skies, and thunder$(li)$(#FF69B4)Sleeping/waking$(): special dialogue for bedtime and morning$(li)$(#FF69B4)Joining world$(): announces your arrival to the server$(br2)Every quirk responds to these events differently~

pages.title: Quirk Commands
pages.text: Use $(thing)/quirk$() commands to manage your quirks:$(br2)$(li)$(#FF69B4)/quirk add <name>$() — add a quirk$(li)$(#FF69B4)/quirk remove <name>$() — remove a quirk$(li)$(#FF69B4)/quirk list$() — view your current quirks$(li)$(#FF69B4)/quirk gui$() — open the quirk GUI (if available)$(br2)You can have multiple quirks at once — mix and match as you please~
